peoples_entry.name: Lizardmen
peoples_entry.note: Hypertropic ectothermic saurian autarky of the Great Rift (LORE.md §6.20): six biological size/role castes at 1.25x scale wearing reptile heads and counterbalancing tails (`mod_head_lizard`, `mod_tail`). Zero trade, zero iron/steel, and zero woven cloth — all regalia and panoply are archaic Shang/Zhou verdigris cast bronze (`leiwen` thunder-spirals, `whorl` coils, `taotie` masks), oxblood & ebony beetle-wing lacquer, butchered hexapod chitin, carved bone, and bundled marsh-reed (6 castes at 100% M/F parity; tools/garments/cultures/lizardmen.py).
